summary: VCI Global filed a 6-K describing a $125 million Equity Purchase Agreement (ELOC) with Hudson Global Ventures, a Nevada LLC, dated September 23, 2026, plus Dune and FirstFire convertible note transactions. The issuer holds a 36-month right, not obligation, to put shares up to $2.5 million per notice, priced at 95% of the lowest VWAP benchmark, with a 4.99% ownership cap, 3-day cooldowns, and a 1,171,875-share $0.01 warrant. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine equity-line financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and resale registration overhang.
